retained_trace.note: The source revision is the committed explicit shared-Q5 candidate later promoted unchanged; its candidate traces match the retained 723-dispatch selectors and resources.

selection.candidate: exact SWA GQA3 wave-local gated reducer
selection.scope: Only the split SWA value reducer at c=1; existing normal/tile16 score producers, score and physical scratch, raw BF16 KVLiveSpans, prefill, global attention, and all fallbacks remain unchanged.
selection.ownership: One local128 workgroup owns three adjacent query heads inside one nine-head GQA group. Each lane owns the same dimension for all three heads, replays each head's current max, denominator, and slot-order FMA chain independently, and loads/converts the shared KV-head BF16 value once per visible slot for all three accumulators.

traffic_model.interpretation: This is a source-byte traffic model, not a hardware-counter claim. It excludes cache-line effects and the extra registers/instructions for three independent softmax states; actual timing decides.
